method.classification: D = fixed shape suitable for direct owner-typed decoding/removing generic intermediate (Rust Deserialize; in TS, use owner contract and a targeted boundary codec only where required—an annotation alone is NOT runtime validation). R = retain justified generic/raw boundary. A = already typed, with essential semantic checks retained. U = unresolved; no removal recommendation until named compatibility/provenance/caller proof. Priority is follow-up priority, not runtime defect severity.
method.depth: Function-level producer -> decode -> consumer inspection is recorded by family below. This is not a claim that every line was manually read. Dedicated test/fixture files were mechanically scanned; only relevant witnesses were inspected. External services' implementations and historical releases were not available and are explicitly unresolved where material.
method.mechanical: Every selected source/config/fixture file scanned for Value/RawValue/serde_json/serde_yaml, JSON.parse/.json/from_str/from_slice/from_reader/from_value/Deserialize, unknown/Record/casts/shape checks, numeric representations, and schema/codegen terms. Lexical hits are candidates, not defects; from_str also finds non-JSON parsers and cfg(test) literals.
method.operations: No builds, tests, edits, installations, application/runtime database reads, remote API calls or live-agent actions. Source inventory/hash computations only. Baseline Linux compile defect not investigated.
method.scope: All tracked files under workspaces/tooling, .agents, .config, .github, .githooks, workspaces/runtime/apps/layr and workspaces/runtime/apps/layr-desk, plus every repository-root file. Main workspace libraries excluded from census; named producer/consumer files outside scope followed selectively.
method.selection: git ls-files and rg discovery; authoritative inventory git ls-tree -r --name-only at revision; contents and hashes from git show revision:path. Working-tree line reads followed HEAD equality and no tracked changes in scope.

numericAndSemanticBoundaryChecklist: Exact JSON number representation: canonical modules retain i64/u64, reject float representation; no f64 normalization before signatures or content hashes.

Numeric value domains: int64 schema versus Rust i64 versus JS safe integer; integral lexical spellings and fraction/overflow differ by decoder. Counts, bytes, duration, timestamps, inode ids and arbitrary metrics have distinct owners/units.

Leaf validation does not prove arithmetic: sum of safe counters can exceed safe integer; finite metrics can overflow relative-change arithmetic; cached-token subsets and provider accounting identities need semantic checks.
Build builtAt is fractional epoch seconds; device/inode/mtime-ns are serialized bigint strings. Do not impose integer-only timestamps or convert identity strings to number.
Required nullable != optional nullable; absent != explicit null; serde default=0 is not JSON Schema default insertion generally. The generator has explicit rejection guards that must remain.

Unknown field/variant preservation: generic schemas, vendor event history, JSON probes, Helm metadata, shared AWS cache and signed raw records differ from fixed outputs. Unknown record operations remain in Layr's log.
Codegen output only captures selected schema assertions. Constraint changes need documented support/rejection and caller decode evidence, not only textual regeneration.
Lazy per-key configuration is a semantic boundary: eager validation can reject unrelated invalid project entries; unknown fields can contribute to cache identity.
Direct typed decoding may reject malformed fields formerly defaulted/skipped; any such tightening is a compatibility change requiring owner decision, not automatic cleanup.
Raw signatures/MACs/digests authenticate original or explicitly canonical bytes. Type normalization before verification can change the authenticated meaning.

LayrDesk.deltaEvidence: Git history: 1c2e4c1e3f39bf38de9da1fd8c72706974878ec9 changes sign.rs inside cfg(test), replacing a self-derived expected digest with a literal, and push tests; writer.rs is a dedicated test with changes in 6f7634fbc/5582885b0/027f3cfea. Desk cannot be described as byte-for-byte identical to its manifest.

ownership.Studio: Tooling/root entry points owned by this repository. docs/type-contracts.md:11 names single owners and :43 distinguishes untrusted ingress from generated first-party client types. docs/typescript.md owns language rules. Do not introduce parallel client response validators.
ownership.recommendationBoundary: Both vendor trees are audit-only. Any behavioral/type refactor belongs upstream and should enter Studio through the committed-revision importer; local manifest discrepancies must be acknowledged, not overwritten. Upstream ownership is established from repository provenance, not a remote HEAD query.

summary: 85 family rows cover tooling/root and vendor type families. Every scoped path is mechanically inventoried; function-level traces, output-only producers and unresolved downstream contracts are distinguished. No family count cap was applied. Highest follow-up priorities: generator semantic/numeric fidelity, saved gate evidence decoding, native usage arithmetic and signed/history compatibility. Vendor changes are upstream-only.
